subject.title: feat(mattermost): read channel history with guarded permissions

question: Should Mattermost history reads be opt-in for existing installations, and should provider-owned delegated-read authorization be represented by a generic plugin contract rather than a Mattermost exception in core?
rationale: This PR deliberately changes both the upgrade-time access surface and the owner of a shared authorization gate; code review cannot safely choose that product and security boundary on maintainers’ behalf.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in and a generic seam
options.body: Default the new action off until configured and expose any provider-owned delegated-read exception through a reviewed generic plugin capability.

options.title: Approve default-enabled access
options.body: Accept that existing Mattermost installations gain the read action by default, with a documented release rationale and focused upgrade/security proof.

options.title: Pause the feature direction
options.body: Defer the read action until maintainers define the long-term shared authorization contract for bundled channels.

recommendation.title: Require explicit opt-in and a generic seam
recommendation.body: Default the new action off until configured and expose any provider-owned delegated-read exception through a reviewed generic plugin capability.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor currently owns the concrete implementation and can apply the selected direction, although current-main feature ownership was not established.
